dialogues.speaker: Muli
dialogues.text: Hello there, tall guest. Do you know how to fish?

dialogues.speaker: Muli
dialogues.text: Then let's go fishing together! Fishing is one of the most interesting things in the world!

dialogues.speaker: Muli
dialogues.text: Really? In that case, do you... think it's possible to fish up jadeware?

dialogues.speaker: Muli
dialogues.text: Bye! I'm going to continue thinking about fishing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why would you even think that...

dialogues.speaker: Muli
dialogues.text: I love fishing, especially when it's with Qiongjiu!

dialogues.speaker: Muli
dialogues.text: But father says that someone must take over our family's jade business...

dialogues.speaker: Muli
dialogues.text: So it would be perfect if I could fish up some jadeware! Don't you think so too!?

dialogues.speaker: Muli
dialogues.text: Or maybe I'll ask Little Mao to learn how to make jadeware while I go fishing with Qiongjiu! That would be great too!
